verdicts.reason: A keeps the title and divider inside the white card, but the card is a short band in the middle of a tall canvas with roughly 60% dead light-blue space above and below. The hydrangea cluster is broken into scattered sprigs inside the card, the two rose ornaments float above the title instead of flanking it, and the title is small. B falls apart: the flowers float detached at the top, the arched card is empty, the title sits below the card outside it with the rose ornaments colliding with the card's bottom border, the divider is stranded at the very bottom, and most of the canvas is dead space.
